intent: When any player drops a bomb, a ring spreads out from it and fades, so everyone (players and spectators) sees the danger zone before the blast knocks players out.
accept: Every lit bomb shows a ring centred on it whose radius grows from 0 to 3 tiles over its first 2 seconds
The ring fades out as it expands and is gone after 2 seconds, with no ring left once the bomb has exploded
The ring is visible in the before/after clip for bombs of any player and does not hide players
